title: The Engineer's Apprentice
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: On a terraformed moon, a teenage apprentice to the great Engineer discovers the machines are dreaming — and the dreams are warnings.
style: Clear, wonder-filled third-person YA sci-fi. Hard-ish tech softened by awe. Fast but thoughtful.
characters: Sefu — 15, apprentice, curious, careful; the Engineer — older, cryptic, kind.
setting: A terraformed moon colony, far future.
notes: Open in the machine hall where Sefu notices a turbine humming a tune it shouldn't know. Wonder first, mystery second.
